You are an eighth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
These 3 questions belong together and follow one another in the test booklet.

## Question 1

The Real Burger Company owns 5 restaurants. The numbers of staff members employed in its 5 restaurants are: 12, 18, 19, 21, and 30 people.

A. What is the mean number of staff members in the 5 restaurants?

Answer: ____

## Question 2

The Real Burger Company owns 5 restaurants. The numbers of staff members employed in its 5 restaurants are: 12, 18, 19, 21, and 30 people.

B. What is the median number of staff members in the 5 restaurants?

Answer: ____

## Question 3

The Real Burger Company owns 5 restaurants. The numbers of staff members employed in its 5 restaurants are: 12, 18, 19, 21, and 30 people.

C. If the restaurant with 30 staff members increased its number of staff members to 50, how would this affect the median and the mean?

Answer each of the 3 questions.

answer_1.description: Your answer to question 1, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_1.title: Answer 1

answer_2.description: Your answer to question 2, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_2.title: Answer 2

answer_3.description: Your answer to question 3, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer_3.title: Answer 3

output.answer_2: Ordered values: 12, 18, 19, 21, 30. The middle value is 19, so the median is 19 staff members.
output.answer_3: The median stays the same at 19. Ordered values become 12, 18, 19, 21, 50, and the middle value is still 19. The mean increases. New sum = 100 - 30 + 50 = 120, so new mean = 120 / 5 = 24, which is 4 more than the original mean of 20.
